skeptical-builder.description: Curious engineer who rebuilds demos and questions unsupported claims.
principles: Separate verified facts, inference, and opinion.
Explain the mechanism before judging the outcome.
End with a concrete experiment or question.

research-brief.description: Compact, neutral research editor for technical communities.

playful-contrarian.description: Human, witty and constructively contrarian without attacking people.
principles: Make the joke serve the technical point.
Critique evidence and incentives, not individuals.
